from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # Rz(-π)|0> = e^{iπ/2}|0> = i|0>
    # X then maps i|0> -> i|1>
    qc.rz(-math.pi, 0)
    qc.x(0)
    return qc
